name: Lunaris
description: A clean, minimal ROM focused on stability and performance.
longDescription: Lunaris is a clean, minimal ROM focused on stability and performance. It delivers smooth animations, optimized battery life, and a near-stock experience with carefully selected customizations. Built for users who want their phone to just work — no bloat, no gimmicks, just a solid daily driver.
changelog: v1.0 — Initial build for Nothing Phone (3a) Lite, CMF Phone 2 Pro, CMF Phone 1

name: Evolution X
description: Pixel-inspired ROM with tons of customization options.
longDescription: Evolution X brings the best of Pixel to your Nothing device. With OTA updates, Pixel launcher, Pixel-exclusive features, and a massive theme engine, it's the ROM for people who want Pixel vibes without buying a Pixel. Highly customizable yet stable enough for daily use.
changelog: v1.0 — Initial build with full Pixel feature set

name: crDroid
description: Feature-rich ROM based on AOSP with a focus on customization and performance.
longDescription: crDroid is one of the most feature-packed custom ROMs available. Built on AOSP with a focus on customization and performance, it offers hundreds of toggles for the status bar, lockscreen, navigation, and more. If you love tweaking every aspect of your phone, crDroid is for you.
changelog: v1.0 — Initial build with full crDroid feature set

name: AxionOS
description: A lightweight AOSP-based ROM with carefully selected features.
longDescription: AxionOS is a lightweight AOSP-based ROM with carefully selected features. It's fast, clean, and gets out of your way. No unnecessary bloat, no confusing settings — just a refined Android experience that respects your time and your hardware.

name: Project Infinity X
description: Endless customization possibilities for power users.
longDescription: Project Infinity X is built for power users who want full control over every aspect of their device. With endless customization possibilities, from UI tweaks to deep system modifications, it's the ROM that lets you make your phone truly yours. Push your device beyond its limits.
changelog: v1.0 — Initial build with full customization suite

name: Project ASCP
description: Android Security & Customization Project. Hardened ROM with extra privacy controls.
longDescription: Project ASCP (Android Security & Customization Project) is a hardened ROM built with privacy and security at its core. It combines extra privacy controls, security patches, and SELinux hardening with a clean customization layer. For users who care about what runs on their device and who can see their data.
changelog:
v1.0 — Initial release for Nothing Phone (3a) Lite
- Hardened SELinux policies
- Privacy dashboard
- Android 17 base

name: Rising OS
description: A rising star in the custom ROM scene. Clean UI and thoughtful features.
longDescription: Rising OS is a rising star in the custom ROM scene. It combines a clean, modern UI with thoughtful features that actually improve your daily experience. Built with attention to detail, excellent device support, and a community-driven approach to development.
changelog: v1.0 — Initial build with modern UI and features

name: Avium UI
description: Elegant and smooth ROM with a focus on UI polish and user experience.
longDescription: Avium UI is elegance personified in a custom ROM. With a focus on UI polish, beautiful animations, and a refined design language, it transforms your device into something that feels premium in every interaction. Smooth, beautiful, and a joy to use.
changelog: v1.0 — Initial build with polished UI and animations
